info.about: Blur is a 2010 arcade-style racing vehicular combat video game for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. It was developed by Bizarre Creations and published by Activision.
info.trivia: It was the penultimate game from Bizarre Creations, which Activision shut down in February 2011.
info.why: A sequel on a new engine was cancelled when Activision closed Bizarre Creations, so this is the only Blur.
